s: The woman who gave great service to Buddhism during the time of Ikshvaku?
x:
Bodhisiri was one of the greatest patrons of Buddhism during the Ikshvaku period. The Nagarjunakonda inscriptions record her generous donations towards the construction of viharas, chaityas, monasteries and other Buddhist institutions. Her contributions supported monks belonging to different Buddhist sects and helped Nagarjunakonda emerge as one of the leading centres of Buddhist learning in South India. Her inscriptions provide valuable evidence for the active role played by women in promoting Buddhism during the Ikshvaku period.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
n: Greatest Buddhist woman patron under Ikshvakus – Bodhisiri
